R10-001-core-word.rationale: "components"->"parts" and "assimilated"->"integrated" are both meaning-preserving synonyms and the sentence reads naturally.

R10-001-calib-single_word.rationale: "assimilated"->"integrated" preserves the meaning of being incorporated into the body and reads naturally.

R10-001-calib-word_plus_sound.rationale: Identical substitution to the single-word case; "assimilated"->"integrated" preserves meaning and reads naturally.

R10-005-core-word.rationale: "reabsorbed"->"absorbed" still fully conveys re-absorption because "back into the blood" carries the return-to-blood meaning.

R10-008-core-dense_mixed_generic.rationale: "stroke" was replaced with "travel", a nonsensical word that is not a disease and breaks the list of NCDs entirely.

R10-013-calib-word_plus_sound.rationale: "products" (chemistry term) was replaced with "goods" (commercial term), which is nonsensical in this context, and "accompanied by" was loosened to "followed by", subtly shifting a simultaneous relationship into a sequential one.

R10-014-core-dense_mixed_generic.rationale: "chemical reactions"->"chemical actions" breaks the standard scientific term, and "reactants"->"precursors" is an imprecise near-synonym, but the sentence remains interpretable.

R10-015-core-word.rationale: "Typically"->"Generally" and "increasing temperature"->"rising temperatures" are natural, meaning-preserving substitutions.

R10-016-core-word.rationale: "bimolecular" (a chemistry term about two molecules) was replaced with "bifocal" (relating to eyeglasses), producing a nonsensical, wrong-sense substitution.

R10-019-core-sparse_common_sound.rationale: "speed"->"pace" is fine, but "straight line"->"direct line" breaks the standard physics phrasing for rectilinear motion, reading slightly unnaturally though the meaning is preserved.

R10-021-core-sparse_common_sound.rationale: "the same magnitude"->"the like magnitude" is an ungrammatical use of "like" as an adjective with "the", making the phrase read as an error.

R10-022-core-multi_sound.rationale: "constant speed"->"constant hurry" substitutes a word meaning rushing for the physics quantity of speed, producing a nonsensical reading, and "straight line"->"even line" is also an unnatural substitution.

R10-023-core-word.rationale: "the body do not accelerate"->"the body do not change" drops the precise Newtonian concept of acceleration for a vague term that could wrongly imply the body cannot move at all.

R10-024-core-dense_mixed_generic.rationale: "second body" was replaced first with "forward body" and then with "intermediate body", introducing extra, undefined entities into Newton's third-law statement about two bodies and garbling the logic.

R10-029-core-word.rationale: "sufficiently massive a black hole" was reduced to "a sufficient black hole", dropping "massive" and producing an ungrammatical, near-circular clause that no longer expresses the mass-threshold condition.

R10-031-core-word.rationale: "volcanic ash"->"volcano ash" breaks the standard adjective form of the fixed term but remains understandable and meaning-preserving.

R10-031-calib-multi_word.rationale: Same substitution as the core-word case: "volcanic ash"->"volcano ash" breaks the fixed adjective form but stays understandable.

R10-031-calib-multi_sound.rationale: "below the surface"->"below the grade" replaces "surface" with a word most readers will read as slope/rating rather than ground level, changing what the magma chamber is described as being beneath.

R10-031-calib-sparse_common_sound.rationale: "below the surface"->"below the rise" substitutes a word implying a specific hill/elevation for the general concept of ground surface, changing the meaning.

R10-031-calib-dense_mixed_generic.rationale: "below the surface"->"below the grade" replaces "surface" with a word most readers will read as slope/rating rather than ground level, changing what the magma chamber is described as being beneath.

R10-032-core-word.rationale: "convergent tectonic activity"->"converged tectonic activity" swaps the standard geological adjective for an awkward past-participle form, though the meaning is still recoverable; the subject-verb agreement was actually improved.

R10-032-core-dense_mixed_generic.rationale: "resulting from" was replaced with the non-idiomatic "leading from" and "happening from", both of which are ungrammatical collocations that obscure the causal relationship being described.

R10-037-core-word.rationale: "continuously"->"continually" loses the precise distinction between uninterrupted occurrence and merely frequent/repeated occurrence.

R10-037-calib-single_word.rationale: "continuously"->"continually" loses the precise distinction between uninterrupted occurrence and merely frequent/repeated occurrence.
